text:
𝗟𝗜𝗧𝗧𝗢𝗡 𝗠𝗔𝗞𝗘𝗦 𝗛𝗜𝗦𝗧𝗢𝗥𝗬! 🧤🔥

Bangladesh keeper Litton Das took 8 dismissals in a Test innings vs SA: 6 catches, 2 stumpings.
Beat Wasim Bari's 7, set in 1979.

A ton and 8 dismissals 👏

#SAvBAN #Cricket

👉 Litton Das ne Johannesburg Test mein ek innings mein 8 dismissals liye
👉 6 catches aur 2 stumpings
👉 Wasim Bari ka 7 ka record (Auckland, 1979) toot gaya
👉 Pehli innings mein 120 runs bhi banaye

Wicketkeeper ho toh aisa! Aapke hisaab se best keeper kaun? Comment karo 👇
